disclosures.title: older bond and standing notes
disclosures.body: Carried from the per-chamber plans, not confirmed on the wiki: Update 35.1 (Feb 2024) cut rank-up bond costs hard, so stage-1-reset bond guides no longer apply; Update 36.0 moved bounty bond drops to the final stage and halved Ticker's credit costs. Ticker sells cheap Training and Shelter bonds for credits and materials, and his rotating cases are worth checking early since a rare bond tier can be the bottleneck. Profit-Taker always drops 3 Medical, 2 Advances and 1 Familial bond per run once available. The Exploiter Orb (Deck 12, needs Diluted Thermia) drops trade-in gems worth a day's standing in one squad run, and Conservation (Kubrodon, Bolarola, Stover) is the fastest standing route to Doer.

disclosures.title: which rank Father wants
disclosures.body: The wiki's Kitgun page says every gild needs Solaris United Doer, while its Gilding page says Rank 3 of the appropriate syndicate, which for Father is Entrati Associate. The older Vermisplicer plan asked for Associate; the older Sporelacer plan said to plan for Doer in case the blanket gate applies. You reach Doer for the Fortuna chambers anyway.

disclosures.title: parts for a build you'll actually use
disclosures.body: Ramble is 750 standing at Neutral; Haymaker and Gibber are 1,000 at Outworlder; Bashrack and Slapneedle are 2,000 at Rapscallion; Splat is 4,000 at Cove. Haymaker and Splat are the community's usual secondary pairing (Tombfinger, Catchmoon, Sporelacer). Haymaker takes 5 Goblite Tears, 30 Travocyte Alloy, 20 Scrap and 10 Recaster Neural Relay; Splat takes 40 Auroxium Alloy, 10 Star Amarast, 20 Scrap and 5 Synathid Ecosynth Analyzer; each is 5,000 credits and 1h. The older Sporelacer plan put Cove at 141,000 standing of rank-ups and said Splat can be claimed as Cove's free rank-up vendor item; neither is confirmed on the wiki. The older Rattleguts plan said primary grips (Brash, Shrewd) start at Outworlder.

disclosures.title: Sporelacer and Fortuna
disclosures.body: The older Sporelacer plan gated it behind Fortuna and a Cove-rank Haymaker and Splat build. The wiki sells Sporelacer at Father for 500 standing at Neutral, and parts mix freely across both vendors, so that pairing is a build choice. Father also sells Palmaris (primary grip) at Neutral and Macro Thymoid at Stranger for 1,000. The older Vermisplicer plan noted the grip sets a beam chamber's range more than its damage, with Palmaris (28 m) a common pick; the range figure is not confirmed on the wiki.

rows.label: Build Kitgun
rows.note: chamber, grip and loader at either vendor; 4,000 credits, instant

rows.label: gild at Rude Zuud
rows.note: Catchmoon, Gaze, Rattleguts, Tombfinger at rank 30; Doer, 10 Shelter Debt-Bonds and 5,000 standing each

rows.label: gild at Father
rows.note: Sporelacer, Vermisplicer at rank 30; 25 Father Tokens and 5,000 standing each

conditions: An ungilded Kitgun earns no Mastery however far it is levelled, and cannot be polarized, renamed, given a Focus Lens or take Kitgun Arcanes; it can take an Orokin Catalyst.
Gilding adds a polarity and a custom name, unlocks Kitgun Arcanes and resets the gun to rank 0, so each chamber is two trips to rank 30.
A built Kitgun cannot be disassembled. Primary and secondary versions of a chamber share one Mastery entry, so a second gun on the same chamber is worth nothing.
bonuses: Father Tokens come from turning Cambion Drift resources in to Father and can be stockpiled ahead of the gild, even past the daily standing cap.
Don't Forma before gilding: the gild supplies a free polarity.

disclosures.title: gild cost in the older plans
disclosures.body: The per-chamber plans priced each gild at 5,000 credits. The wiki's Kitgun page prices it at 5,000 standing with the vendor's syndicate, plus 10 Shelter Debt-Bonds at Rude Zuud or 25 Father Tokens at Father. The older Sporelacer plan also offered gilding an Infested Kitgun at Rude Zuud with Shelter bonds instead of Father Tokens; the wiki does not confirm cross-vendor gilding.

disclosures.title: chamber quirks
disclosures.body: Update 32.0 cut Gaze's ammo pool to 200, and most players call Pax Charge close to mandatory on a Gaze they mean to use. Sporelacer's explosions self-stagger at close range, so bring stagger immunity before using it point-blank. A Mastery-only chamber can take the cheap parts for good; a real build needs its own chamber.
